'''2007 Kashyyyk Regionals Bill Kafer LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2007 Kashyyyk Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' BFred said this doesn't beat anything
* '''Username:''' tacobill
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
